Modifications: real3D BVH ray-triangle surface retarget onto NC connected topology, 99% core donor hit plus1% source regularization, broad smooth neck/temple/scalp transition; knownR05 curl relief removed and bounded source cap cage. Originals retained unchanged. No endorsement implied. Combined adaptation/imagery retains NC-SA4.0; original donor remains CC BY4.0. R06f additionally fairs a measured 3D source scalp radial field, with compact anisotropic deformation of existing scalp and restrained Taubin fairing of actual head triangles; no synthetic head replacement. R06g fairs the actual inherited scalp ridge with 300 pinned-boundary Laplacian steps and reduces lower-cheek scan chatter with 60 Taubin pairs. R06h carves fine shallow spiral curl relief directly into the same continuous scalp; sampled original scalp vertex roots and tangent frames retained. R06j, after rejecting I for excessive ear/jaw smoothing, repositions the anterior ear attachment posteriorly and inward, preserves the ear bowl/rim through smooth anchors, and blends side-cheek/jaw curvature with gentler connected-mesh fairing. Actual donor eyelid/nose/lip cores and all body positions below Y2.15 remain exact. Ear attachment is a declared reshaped derivative. R08a rejects the R07 donor-cheek transplant and retains the entire uncut continuous J/NC face. Conforming refinement adds source-supported feature detail; actual saved donor triangle/barycentric targets and exact closest points on neighboring source triangles guide bounded eye/brow/nose/lip geometry, without transplanting the donors worn cheeks. Existing source ears turn coherently, with direct original-NC triangle/barycentric ancestry. Actual irregular coil roots and raised curls are sculpted on the connected scalp; standard aged-gold vertex color keeps the original metalness/roughness/roughnessMap. Original inputs and all rejected candidates remain.
